narrative: Material PL3__M8E7DBB2 exhibits erratic demand (CV 0.67, 76.3% non-zero days) with unstable lead times (mean 0.75 days, CV 1.16). The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock and orders in MOQ batches of 34, generating ~2,011 orders/year at extreme cost. The recommended (r,Q) continuous review policy sets reorder point at 913 units and order quantity at 1,676 units, cutting total annual cost by 94.8% while targeting 95% service level. Storage capacity utilization of 76.2% remains comfortably within the 2,818-unit limit.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Continuous review (r,Q) is optimal for erratic demand with unstable lead times: it responds immediately when inventory crosses the reorder point, preventing stockouts without requiring fixed review intervals. EOQ-derived order quantity (1,676 units) far exceeds MOQ (34), making batch consolidation the key lever for cost reduction.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity utilization at 76.2% (2,146 / 2,818 units) provides adequate buffer. Safety stock of 470 units covers 95% of demand-supply uncertainty during the effective 1.62-day lead time. No capacity binding detected.
